citations.quote: Starting 30 November 2024, ie, after the parallel run period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by IPD must be submitted via e-IP.
The current submission requests from IPD via the IP E-submission system will be integrated into e-IP, including reporting of net asset values, large redemptions and suspensions of dealing.
In addition, e-IP users can also settle recurring annual fees associated with relevant investment products through the new system.
to streamline and enhance the efficiency of processing new product applications and post-authorisation/registration submissions to IPD.

1 Investment-linked assurance schemes, mandatory provident fund products, open-ended fund companies, paper gold schemes, pooled retirement funds, real estate investment trusts, unit trusts and mutual funds and unlisted structured investment products.

reading.distinction: The prior models leave application/submission classification undifferentiated. The source separates mandatory applications and submissions, including operational reports migrating from IP E-submission, from the additional ability to pay recurring annual fees. A single transaction-channel Boolean could incorrectly make fee payment through e-IP mandatory or let an e-IP payment stand in for a report transmitted elsewhere. Assessment must follow each submission component. Scope is also separated from the result, avoiding the prior models' opposing treatment of out-of-scope items as false or vacuously true.

reading.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] For an application or submission component concerning an IPD-administered investment product made on or after 30 November 2024, does that component comply with the stated mandatory e-IP route? True means the component was submitted through e-IP; false means it was not. This result addresses only that route requirement, not fee-payment routing or overall legal compliance.
reading.subject: An individual application or submission component, including an operational report

relationships: A participant submits an application or report concerning a product administered by IPD.
A transaction may contain a submission and an associated annual fee payment; their channels require separate factual assessment.
IPD submission requests handled through IP E-submission are to be integrated into e-IP.
The mandatory route attaches to covered applications and submissions from the cutover date.
The statement that users can also settle annual fees describes a payment capability without expressly imposing a mandatory payment route.
proposals.temporal_basis: Assess each application or submission at its own submission date; the mandatory route begins on 2024-11-30.
proposals.unit_of_assessment: One individual application or submission component, separated from any associated recurring annual fee payment
